title: OBVIL — corpus d'éditions anciennes françaises (Teinte)
notes: Born-digital TEI corpora of early-modern French texts from LabEx OBVIL (Sorbonne Université), encoded with the Teinte toolchain (lauze_apologie-danse_1623, Faceties 1557, La Bruyère 1694, etc.); CC BY-NC-ND. The lab's data platform ObTIC (obtic.sorbonne-universite.fr/corpus, verified) indexes the freely available OBVIL corpora; the reading corpus pages live on the OBVIL GitHub organisation (https://github.com/OBVIL), and obvil.sorbonne-universite.fr refused connections at check time. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, including retained duplicates; harvested subset).
license_note: Includes CC-BY-NC-ND-3.0-FR, CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Licences or rights differ by text, corpus or editorial layer; consult the source terms for the selected material.
